game_start.intro: Mchezo unaanza. Suti ya trump: {trump_suit} (karti ya trump: {trump_str}).

player_prompt.intro:
Uko kama Mwari {player_id} katika Whist ya Kijerumani.
{phase_info}
Una mikono {hand_size}.
Cheza karti kwa '[play N]', ambapo N ni nafasi yake kwenye mkono wako (kwa mfano '[play 3]').
player_prompt.phase_learning: Icyiciro cyo kwiga: uwatsinze buri gisigo afata ikarita yerekana kandi uwazimiye akuramo ikarita ikurikira mu nkuge. Ibikorwa byatsinzwe muri iki cyiciro ntabwo bibarwa ku ntsinzi.
player_prompt.phase_playing: Gukina: igikapu cyararangiye. Buri gitego kuva ubu kiraba mu gutsinda.

next_card.playing_phase: Nta karita igenda itangwa - igihe cyo gukina cyaratangiye.
next_card.deck_empty: Nta karita iriho, nta n'ikarito irimo.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Uburyo budasobanutse bwo guhinduranya. Koresha '[play N]' kugirango ukine ikarita ya Nth mu ntoki zawe.
invalid_move.bad_position: Iyo karita ntaho ihuriye n'ibyo. Ufite ikarita {hand_size} .
invalid_move.must_follow_suit: Ugomba gukurikiza urugero rwe maze ukagena ikarita {lead_suit}.

trick.won_learning: Mwari {winner_id} anashinda mkwano huo na {card} na kuchukua karti iliyo wazi.

phase.learning_complete: Urutonde rwarangiye. Icyiciro cyo kwiga cyararangiye - buri gitego gisigaye gifatwa nk'icya ngombwa kugira ngo umuntu atsinde.

draw.loser_received: Watsinzwe umukino maze ugakuramo {card} mu ikarita.

turn.scores_learning: Mikwano iliyoshinda hadi sasa - Mwari 0: {tricks0}, Mwari 1: {tricks1}

board_str.header: === Ikiganiro cyo mu rurimi rw'Ikidage GAME WIST===

outcome.summary: Learning phase - Player 0: {l0}, Player 1: {l1}. Playing phase - Player 0: {p0}, Player 1: {p1}. Player {winner_id} wins with {winner_tricks} scoring tricks!
